metadata.description: Claude Code plugins used by the Torizon team.

plugins.name: torizon-pre-push-triage
plugins.description: Pre-push triage for the Torizon Yocto layers and toradex-manifest: deterministic checks, commit-message and layer review agents, a bitbake parse and a stamp the pre-push hook checks; after the PR/MR is opened as a draft, an independent review and a 'review done' comment.

plugins.name: bitbake-watch
plugins.description: Live BitBake build progress above the prompt: follows the running build, or a build dir or log given to /bbwatch.

plugins.name: pending-board
plugins.description: A pane of pending work items (tickets, PRs, follow-ups) that Claude keeps current, with a monitor tab for the GitHub PRs and GitLab MRs behind them.
